_comment: TEMPLATES, NOT LOADED. Bifrost never reads this file. To use a provider, copy its block into the "providers" object of config.json, put its key in ../.env, pass that env var to the container, and add the provider to the virtual keys' provider_configs and the routing rule's fallbacks. Provider names and key formats: https://docs.getbifrost.ai/quickstart/gateway/provider-configuration . Every block here is disabled until copied.

local._comment: Replaces the mock 'local' provider. Gemma 4 E2B served by Ollama (or any OpenAI-compatible server such as llama.cpp or vLLM). Check the exact model tag with `ollama list`. With the gateway in Docker host networking, 127.0.0.1 is the host. Ollama ignores the key, but Bifrost wants one.

model_name_notes.local: gemma4:e2b  (placeholder: use the tag Ollama shows)
